jica_manual_ref: Inspired by JICA SHEP PLUS — Root crops production guide (Kenya)

varieties.name: Nantes
varieties.supplier_notes: The Kenyan standard: cylindrical, sweet, the shape greengrocers expect.

varieties.name: Chantenay
varieties.supplier_notes: Short and broad, tolerant of heavier soil.

timeline_template.description_en: Deep-dig 25 cm, remove stones. NEVER apply fresh manure — it forks roots.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chimba kwa kina cha cm 25, ondoa mawe. USIWEKE samadi mbichi — inapinda mizizi.

timeline_template.description_en: Direct-sow 1 cm deep in rows 25-30 cm apart (2-3 kg per acre raw, 1-1.5 kg pelleted). Carrots never transplant.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda moja kwa moja kina cha 1 cm, mistari 25-30 cm (kilo 2-3 kwa eka). Karoti hazipandikizwi.

timeline_template.description_en: Thin to 5-7 cm spacing — the step most farms skip and most yields die on. Crowded carrots stay pencil-thin.
timeline_template.description_sw: Punguza hadi nafasi ya cm 5-7 — hatua inayorukwa na wengi. Karoti zilizosongamana hubaki ndogo.

timeline_template.description_en: Top-dress 50 kg CAN per acre; weed shallow — deep hoeing cuts the roots.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 50 za CAN; palia juu juu — kulima kwa kina kunakata mizizi.

timeline_template.description_en: Second 50 kg CAN per acre; water consistently — alternating wet-dry splits the roots.
timeline_template.description_sw: Kilo 50 za CAN tena; mwagilia kwa utaratibu — kukausha na kulowesha kunapasua mizizi.

timeline_template.description_en: Pull when shoulders show 2-3 cm. Loosen with a fork and pull by the tops — never yank dry soil.
timeline_template.description_sw: Ng'oa wakati mizizi ina upana wa cm 2-3. Legeza na uma kisha vuta — usivute udongo mkavu.
timeline_template.tip_en: Top immediately after harvest — tops suck moisture from the root.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Kata majani mara baada ya kuvuna — majani hunyonya unyevu wa mzizi.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Medium roots (2-3 cm shoulder, 15-20 cm long) fetch top price; oversized to stew markets, undersized to feed.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: 5 kg lots; bunch greens on for premium retail.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Top immediately, wash lightly if the market wants washed, sell within days. Cool storage 1-2 weeks.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Kata majani mara moja, osha kidogo kama soko linataka, uza ndani ya siku chache. Hifadhi baridi wiki 1-2.

diseases.severity_classes: Low (spots) · High (tops burn down, harvest problems)
diseases.symptoms_en: Brown ringed spots on leaves, yellowing, burnt tops in humid weather.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kahawia yenye pete, kuwitikia, majani kuungua unyevu.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered alternaria-active sprays at first spots. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za alternaria zilizoidhinishwa mara madoa yanapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Rotation, clean seed, avoid leaf wetness.
diseases.prevention_sw: Zungusha, mbegu safi, epuka majani kuloweshwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph the TOP growth — root photos show nothing for leaf blight.

diseases.symptoms_en: White dusting on leaves, weak tops, small roots.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Unga mweupe majani, vichwa dhaifu, mizizi midogo.
diseases.treatment_en: Sulphur-class products at first dusting. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za salfa mara inapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: White powder both sides; usually warm-dry weather.

diseases.symptoms_en: Knotted galls on roots, forking, stunted patches.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Uvimbe kwenye mizizi, mizizi iliyopinda, mapande dhaifu.
diseases.treatment_en: None curative — rotation is the treatment. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — kuzungusha ndio dawa. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Rotate with cereals, avoid after tomato/potato.
diseases.prevention_sw: Zungusha na nafaka, epuka baada ya nyanya/viazi.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph washed roots — galls vs forking-from-stones are different causes.

diseases.symptoms_en: Small sunken oval holes under the skin, worse with moisture swings.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Mashimo madogo chini ya ngozi, zaidi kwa kubadilika kwa unyevu.
diseases.treatment_en: None direct — correct calcium + steady watering. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna dawa ya moja kwa moja — rekebisha kalsiamu + mwagilia kwa utaratibu. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Cut roots crosswise to photograph the lesions under the skin.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Prices steadier than leafy crops — carrots store a few days and smooth out the glut. Medium grade tops the band year-round.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Bei thabiti kuliko mboga za majani — karoti hudumu siku chache na kupunguza wingi sokoni. Daraja la kati linaongoza mwaka mzima.
market_notes.price_notes_en: 30–60 KES per kg farm-gate, medium grade at the top (November 2026). Input bill 20,000–35,000 KES per acre.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: KES 30–60 kwa kilo shambani, daraja la kati juu (Novemba 2026). Gharama 20,000–35,000 KES kwa eka.
